candidates.change_summary: Replace require(msg.sender == owner) with require(msg.sender != owner), inverting the access control check so that anyone except the owner can withdraw funds.
Delete the require statement, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll and drain the contract balance.
Replace the transfer call with a selfdestruct to the recipient, radically altering the final state of the contract's balance and existence.
Replace the transfer amount from address(this).balance to a hardcoded 0, causing the function to send zero ether instead of the full balance.
Replace the transfer recipient from _recipient to msg.sender, so the owner sends the contract balance to themselves instead of the specified recipient.
